classical_inverse.algorithm: Filter histories by final rank pair and one-bit tag (14 signatures; at most four candidates). For the full compact state, rebuild each remaining basis and compare the normalized low row; on sampled DQI data, also decode and forward-replay candidates using only ratios, ranks, and tag.

gf12_ratio_rank_tag_replay.scope: All four rank/tag candidates were checked by classical decode and forward recurrence for each sampled valid input. This is not a full-domain proof or a reversible circuit.

rank_tag_candidate_bound.scope: All 32 possible five-pivot histories; this combinatorial bound depends only on rank updates and the tag, not field elements.

classical_inverse.scope: Tests the constructive classical decoder on all GF(8) collision inputs and 64 sampled valid GF(2^12) inputs, and bounds rank/tag candidates across all five-pivot histories; it does not prove all GF(2^12) states or provide a reversible circuit.

decision: The one-bit tag resolves the GF(8) compact-state collisions, and the final ranks plus tag reduce 32 histories to at most four candidates. A classical five-pivot inverse decodes all collision cases plus the sampled GF(2^12) cases; ratio/rank/tag replay is unique on those 64 samples. This remains classical evidence; no reversible eraser, resource schedule, or official verifier result is established.

gf12_dqi_sample.scope: 64 sampled valid error patterns at weights 31 and 35; compatibility evidence only, not a full-domain proof.

gf8_exhaustive.scope: Exhaustive classical information check over all five-word GF(8) inputs.

promotion_gate: The inverse and four-candidate bound are classical only. Compile a reversible candidate check and tag eraser, then require a GF(2^12) correctness argument, Q <= 890, mean T <= 215175.987 at R=1.1912605, the complete 4+66 schedule, and official-verifier PASS.
